metadata.ground_truth_sql:
SELECT 
LOWER(dc.customer_city) AS city, 
SUM(fo.total_order_value) AS total_revenue
FROM 
dim_customers dc
JOIN 
fct_orders fo ON dc.customer_unique_id = fo.customer_unique_id
JOIN 
fct_order_items foi ON fo.order_id = foi.order_id
WHERE 
dc.is_returning_customer = 1
AND LOWER(foi.product_category) = 'watches gifts'
GROUP BY 
LOWER(dc.customer_city)
ORDER BY 
total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

metadata.ground_truth_sql:
WITH top_states AS (
SELECT customer_state, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM fct_orders
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
o.customer_state,
o.has_voucher_payment,
AVG(o.review_score) AS average_review_score
FROM fct_orders o
JOIN top_states ts ON o.customer_state = ts.customer_state
GROUP BY o.customer_state, o.has_voucher_payment
ORDER BY o.customer_state, o.has_voucher_payment;
